ext.description: Open Word, Excel, CSV, PDF, PowerPoint, .vsix, code, images, audio, video, fonts, archives and any binary file inside Antigravity / VS Code.
config.language: Language of the Office Viewer interface. Commands and settings in this list follow the editor display language.
config.useEditorAutoSave: Use the global `#files.autoSave#` setting for Word, Excel and CSV. When off, `#officeViewer.autoSaveTriggers#` applies.
config.autoSaveTriggers: When Office files are saved automatically (several can be chosen). Empty list: only the Save button or Ctrl+S. Ignored while `#officeViewer.useEditorAutoSave#` is on.
config.trigger.onFocusChange: Save when switching to another tab, panel or window, and when closing.
config.trigger.onWindowChange: Save when leaving the Antigravity window, and when closing.
config.pageTheme: Page colour for Word and PDF.
config.fullWidth: Show the Word page at the full panel width (removes margins).
config.fontScale: Font size factor for Word and spreadsheets (1 = 100%).
config.openInEditMode: Open Word, Excel and CSV files directly in edit mode.
config.createBackup: Keep the original as <name>.docx.bak on the first save of a Word file.
config.meetingNoteFileName: File name of a new meeting note. `DD`, `MM`, `YYYY` become today's date. Example: `DD.MM.YYYY` → `22.10.2026.docx`.
config.meetingNoteTemplate: Optional template .docx (full path or relative to the workspace). Empty: the built-in template.
config.browserPath: Browser used to create PDFs (Edge or Chrome). Empty: found automatically.
config.searchFolders: Folders for **Search Notes** and **Action List** (full path or relative to the workspace). Empty: the whole workspace.
config.openAllFiles: Open every file in Office Viewer, code too. Code shows with syntax colours and line numbers; **Edit in editor** opens the normal text editor at the same line. Diff views, unsaved tabs and debugging always use the text editor.
